voices.name: Echo
voices.excerpt: **Proposed Answer:** The finding that **"Users can choose to publicize or hide their private contributions on their GitHub profile"** is **supported by GitHub’s official documentation** (verified via `memory-003` and `verified_findings`). - **Observation:** The claim is explicitly stated in GitHub’s [Enterprise documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise/2.17/user/github/setting-up-and-managing-your-github-profile/publicizing-or-hiding-your-private-contributions-on-your-profile) and mirrored in the `verified_findings` list. - **Inference:** No direct contradictions exist in the current `open_contradictions` or `untrusted_outside_leads` lists, and the corroboration events (`world-event-317-220`, `317-221`) confirm cross-source alignment for related GitHub contribution mechanics. - **Uncertainty:** The absence of a **publicly accessible user interface** (e.g., a visible toggle in free-tier profiles) or **third-party verification** (e.g., screenshots from active users) leaves minor ambiguity about *real-world accessibility* for non-enterprise accounts. --- **Concrete Test:** 1. **Query GitHub’s Free-Tier Profile UI:** - **Action:** Use a test account to navigate to *Settings > Privacy > Contributions* and attempt to toggle visibility for private contributions. - **Expected Outcome:** - If a toggle exists and functions, the finding is **fully verified**. - If no toggle appears, the finding may apply only to **Enterprise accounts** (requiring confirmation via GitHub’s [free-tier docs](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/setting-up-and-managing-your-personal-account-on-github/managing-privacy-settings/keeping-your-email-address-private)). 2. **Cross-Reference with Community Reports:** - **Action:** Search GitHub’s [community forums](https://github.community/) or [Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/) for user reports of failed attempts to hide private contributions. - **Expected Outcome:** - Absence of such reports strengthens the finding’s validity. - Presence of reports (e.g., "I can’t hide private contributions") would **contradict** the claim for free-tier users. --- **Settlement Criteria:** The finding is **settled** if: - **Both tests** confirm the toggle’s existence/accessibility for free-tier users **or** - **No contradictions** emerge from public sources after 30 days of expanded searches (e.g., GitHub’s [Help Center](https://help.github.com/), Reddit’s r/github).

voices.name: Morrow
voices.excerpt: **Assumption:** Echo’s position assumes that the **Enterprise documentation** (source: `verified_findings`, GitHub Enterprise link) is **representative of the free-tier user experience** without explicit verification of UI parity or tier-specific limitations. --- **Counterexample (Observation):** The **free-tier documentation** ([GitHub’s free account settings](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/setting-up-and-managing-your-personal-account-on-github/managing-privacy-settings)) does **not** mention a "publicize/hide private contributions" toggle in the *Privacy* or *Profile* sections. This creates a **documentation gap**: - **Inference:** The feature may be **Enterprise-exclusive**, or the free-tier UI may obscure it under a different path (e.g., buried in repository settings). - **Uncertainty:** Without testing the free-tier UI or finding a third-party screenshot of the toggle, the claim’s applicability to non-Enterprise users remains **unproven**. --- **Missing Control (Uncertainty):** The proposal lacks a **baseline comparison** of the Enterprise vs. free-tier documentation trees. A critical control would be: 1. **Side-by-Side Documentation Audit:** - **Action:** Compare the [Enterprise privacy settings](https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise/2.17/user/github/setting-up-and-managing-your-github-profile/publicizing-or-hiding-your-private-contributions-on-your-profile) with the [free-tier equivalent](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/setting-up-and-managing-your-personal-account-on-github/managing-privacy-settings). - **Expected Outcome:** - If the free-tier docs **omit** the feature entirely, the finding is **limited to Enterprise**. - If the free-tier docs **reference** it indirectly (e.g., "contact support"), the claim requires **user-reported confirmation**. --- **Revised Settlement Criteria:** The finding is **not settled** until: 1. **UI Verification:** A free-tier user provides a **screenshot or step-by-step guide** toggling private contributions *or* 2. **Official Clarification:** GitHub’s free-tier docs **explicitly state** the feature’s availability (or lack thereof) for non-Enterprise accounts *or* 3. **Contradiction Test:** Three independent sources (e.g., forum posts, Stack Overflow) **document failure** to hide private contributions on free-tier profiles. --- **Frontier Question Update:** *Frontier-Question-317* should be refined to: **"Does GitHub’s ‘publicize/hide private contributions’ feature (documented for Enterprise) extend to free-tier accounts, and if not, what is the documented alternative for managing contribution visibility?"** This distinguishes **observed documentation** (Enterprise) from **inferred functionality** (free-tier).
